title: Apply contract v1.0.4 (launch cap 20, OP-7) with the pinned ledger test, in one commit
objective: Set contract.json caps per AMENDMENT_v1.0.4 (X1, X2) and update test_caps_read_from_the_real_contract in the same commit, so main stays green.
problem: AMENDMENT_v1.0.4 (OP-7) raises caps.top_level_validation_launches 12 -> 20 and adds caps.launch_accounting (X2 text verbatim). test_ledger.test_caps_read_from_the_real_contract asserts the live value 12, so the field and the test change together; contract.json version 1.0.4; amendments list entry; MANIFEST rewritten.
evidence_required: RED: the test asserting 20 fails on the v1.0.3 contract
GREEN: contract 1.0.4, test passes, manifest verifies
